title: Innovation: The Bright Side of Common Ownership?
eligible_reason: Main analysis regresses innovation outcomes on continuous common-ownership measures (CO, kappa-weighted technology/product spillovers cospilltec, cospillsic) with firm and year FE and time-varying controls (Tables 3-5, B1-B9). The DiD (Tables 6-7) uses a single shock, the 2009 BlackRock-BGI merger (t2m_blkbgi, event window intck -5..5), with post##treat##(c.spilltec c.spillsic) and post##controls; one adoption date, so not staggered. Data not shipped.
design_notes: do_analysis_main_June2024.do (Stata, #delimit ;).
